_notes: Voice settings for qwen_server.py (round 8, 'v2'). Paths are relative to the studio. See local-voice/README.md.

ref_source.note: mono 24 kHz, no processing; scripts/setup-local-voice.sh cuts it

ref_text: To create a new page, I have to create a new file like this and then I have to write front matter. So this is the process of creating a new page.

gates.note: tail, rise and WER are checked inside qwen_server.py. Accent and likeness are scene-level checks done by scripts/check.dart (gate.max_us 0.2, gate.min_match 0.65 in the video config).

levers.attempts: takes per sentence. 4 = full quality (best_energy keeps the passing take with the most pitch movement); 1 = fast draft.
levers.select: best_energy runs every attempt; first_pass stops at the first take that passes the gates.
levers.level_db: one gain so speech RMS is -19 dBFS, the level of ElevenLabs lines. No other processing.
levers.line gap: tts.dart joins the lines of a scene with 250 ms of silence and pad.dart widens it to the video pace. It is not set here.
